title: Wrapped Initiate-Error-PDU response
purpose: Exercise the initiate-error branch through the same wrapper style used by other MMS-bearing seeds while keeping the inner body compact.
expected_behavior: A receiver should descend through the AARE-like wrapper and route on tag 0xaa to MMS initiate-error handling.
constraints_preserved: MMS inner tag 0xaa for Initiate-Error-PDU is preserved.
Length bytes are definite and internally consistent.
The message remains fully wrapped rather than a raw PDU.
issue_safety_notes: Error-path coverage only; no malformed or exploit-specific content is included.
